title: Pink Holiday Party Outfits
label: Party Outfits
intro: Holiday party outfits should work for three parties in a row, not one. A pink velvet mini dress does the office party with black tights and the friend party with bare legs and a bow. Add crystal drops, sparkly Mary Janes, a beaded bag and a faux fur jacket for the walk to the car.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on pink satin of a pink velvet mini dress, black tights, glitter Mary Janes, a satin bow clip, crystal drop earrings, a cream beaded bag and a faux fur jacket.
Mirror selfie on a farmhouse landing with garland of a woman in a pink velvet mini dress, black tights and glitter Mary Janes, faux fur jacket over her arm, phone covering face.
